ja: 店長が新しい企画、すごくいいって言ってくれて、めっちゃ嬉しかった。
en: I was so happy when the manager told me the new plan was really good.
alternatives: I was really happy when the manager said the new plan was great.
It made me so happy when the manager told me the new plan was really good.
point: told me の後は時制を合わせて is ではなく was

ja: 上司に本当の気持ちを伝えたほうがいいと思うよ。
en: I think you should tell your boss how you really feel.
alternatives: I think you should tell your boss what you really think.
I think you should let your boss know how you really feel.
point: 「気持ち」は how you feel と節で表すと自然

ja: 最近ずっと夜よく眠れてなくて、正直ちょっと参ってきてるんだ。
en: I haven't been sleeping well lately, and to be honest, it's kind of wearing me down.
alternatives: I haven't been sleeping well recently, and honestly, it's kind of getting to me.
I haven't been getting much sleep lately, and to be honest, it's wearing me down a bit.
point: 「最近ずっと〜してない」は haven't been ~ing で継続を出す

ja: 彼は転職を考えているみたいだけど、今辞めるのはもったいないと私は思う。
en: He seems to be thinking about changing jobs, but I think quitting now would be a waste.
alternatives: It looks like he's considering changing jobs, but I think it'd be a shame to quit now.
He seems to be thinking of switching jobs, but I think quitting now would be a waste.
point: about の後は動名詞 changing、主語の「辞めるのは」も quitting

ja: もし宝くじで1億円当たったら、あなたは仕事を辞める？それとも続ける？
en: If you won a hundred million yen in the lottery, would you quit your job or keep working?
alternatives: Would you quit your job or keep working if you won a hundred million yen in the lottery?
If you won a hundred million yen in the lottery, would you quit or keep your job?
point: ありえない仮定は if 節を過去形、主節を would にする

ja: あんなこと言うべきじゃなかったな。彼女、きっと傷ついたと思う。
en: I shouldn't have said that. She must have been hurt.
alternatives: I shouldn't have said something like that. She must have been hurt.
I shouldn't have said that. I bet she was hurt.
point: 過去への後悔は shouldn't have、過去の推量は must have

ja: 正直言うと、一番がっかりしたのは誰も手伝ってくれなかったことです。
en: To be honest, what disappointed me most was that nobody helped me.
alternatives: Honestly, the most disappointing thing was that no one helped me.
To be honest, what let me down the most was that nobody helped me.
point: 「〜なのは」は what 節、「〜ということ」は that 節で表す

ja: 天気のせいで週末の予定をあきらめることになって、あなたはがっかりしてないの？
en: Aren't you disappointed that you had to give up your weekend plans because of the weather?
alternatives: Aren't you disappointed you had to give up your plans for the weekend because of the weather?
Don't you feel let down that the weather made you give up your weekend plans?
point: 「あきらめる」は give up。「〜することになった」は had to で表す

ja: 兄は口では平気だと言っているけど、本当はかなりがっかりしていると思う。
en: Although my brother says he's fine, I think he's actually pretty disappointed.
alternatives: My brother says he's fine, but I think he's actually really disappointed.
Even though my brother says he's okay, I think he's actually pretty let down.
point: although の後は節が続く。but と一緒に使わない

ja: 兄に無理やりホラー映画を最後まで見させられて、正直ちょっとムッとしました。
en: My brother made me sit through a horror movie, and honestly, I was a little annoyed.
alternatives: My brother forced me to sit through a horror movie, and to be honest, I was a bit annoyed.
My brother made me watch a whole horror movie, and honestly, it annoyed me a little.
point: 「無理やり〜させる」は make 人 動詞の原形。sit through で最後まで耐える

ja: コンサートが中止になったと聞いて、私はすごくがっかりしたよ。
en: I was really disappointed to hear that the concert had been canceled.
alternatives: I was so disappointed to hear the concert had been canceled.
It was really disappointing to hear that the concert was canceled.
point: 感情の原因は to hear、中止は受け身 had been canceled

ja: 明日の朝もまだ雨が降ってたら、家にいたほうがよくない？
en: Wouldn't it be better to stay home if it's still raining tomorrow morning?
alternatives: If it's still raining tomorrow morning, wouldn't it be better to stay home?
Shouldn't we just stay home if it's still raining tomorrow morning?
point: 未来でも if 節は現在形 it's still raining

ja: 新しい仕事、最初は緊張したけど、もう慣れたよ。
en: I was nervous at first, but I've gotten used to my new job.
alternatives: My new job made me nervous at first, but I've gotten used to it.
I was nervous at first, but I'm used to my new job now.
point: 「最初は」は過去形、「もう慣れた」は現在完了で

ja: あの頃、自分の気持ちにもっと正直になっていればよかったって、今でも時々思うんだ。
en: I sometimes still wish I'd been more honest about my feelings back then.
alternatives: I still sometimes wish I had been more honest about how I felt back then.
Sometimes I still wish I'd been more upfront about my feelings back then.
point: 過去への後悔は wish の後を過去完了（I'd been）にする
